exposure: age of presentation (1-12 months vs 13-72 months)
cohort: The study included 253 infants and toddlers diagnosed with Pediatric Feeding Disorder (PFD), with a median age of 16.4 months at diagnosis.
finding: Infants under 1 year old with PFD were significantly more likely to be girls and preterm, had more hospitalizations, and needed more prescription medications compared to children aged 13-72 months with PFD.
